subject.about: IS-Net general use (DIS, Apache-2.0), converted to MNN with 8-bit weights. Source: https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/download/v0.0.0/isnet-general-use.onnx

sam_encoder.about: MobileSAM image encoder (Apache-2.0), converted to MNN with 8-bit weights. Source: https://huggingface.co/Acly/MobileSAM (mobile_sam_image_encoder.onnx)

sam_decoder.about: SAM mask decoder for MobileSAM (Apache-2.0), converted to MNN with 8-bit weights. Source: https://huggingface.co/Acly/MobileSAM (sam_mask_decoder_single.onnx)

depth.about: Depth Anything V2 Small (Apache-2.0; only the Small model is), converted to MNN with 8-bit weights. Source: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/depth-anything-v2-small (onnx/model.onnx)

eraser.about: Big LaMa inpainting (Apache-2.0), 512 x 512, converted to MNN with half-precision weights (8-bit weights break its Fourier layers). In two parts: GitHub limits files to 100 MB. Source: https://huggingface.co/Carve/LaMa-ONNX (lama_fp32.onnx)

upscale.about: Real-ESRGAN realesr-general-x4v3 (BSD-3-Clause), 4x upscale, exported to ONNX from the official weights and converted to MNN with half-precision weights. Source: https://github.com/xinntao/Real-ESRGAN/releases/download/v0.2.5.0/realesr-general-x4v3.pth
